## File: src/vug/html_extractor.cr

Rename these private methods:

| Current (4+ words) | Proposed |
|---|---|
| `validate_and_parse_url` | `parse_validated_url` |
| `process_data_url_favicon` | `process_data_favicon` |
| `extract_favicons_from_html` | `extract_html_favicons` |

Also rename these private helper methods in the same file:
| `process_favicon_link` (3 words, fine) | keep |
| `process_normal_favicon` (3 words, fine) | keep |
| `add_manifest_favicons` (3 words, fine) | keep |
| `build_html_headers` (3 words, fine) | keep |

Update all internal callers. No public API change. Run `crystal spec` to verify.
title: Shorten private methods in HtmlExtractor (3 methods)
